BennettDeterminantConstant.lean:
import D1Bound5.BennettResidualCancellation
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Roots
import Mathlib.Algebra.CharZero.Infinite

open Finset

namespace D1Bound5

variable {F I : Type*} [Field F] [CharZero F]
variable [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

/-- The arbitrary-order cleared polynomial matrix used in node removal. -/
noncomputable def bennettClearedMatrix (a : I → F) (k : ℕ) (ν : F) :
    Matrix I I (Polynomial F) :=
  Matrix.of fun i j ↦ bennettClearedResidue Finset.univ a k ν i j

/-- Homogenization of the actual matrices, with all scalar powers retained. -/
theorem bennettClearedMatrix_eval (a : I → F) (k : ℕ) (ν N : F) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    (bennettClearedMatrix a k ν).map (Polynomial.evalRingHom N) =
      N ^ k • (bennettPolynomialMatrix a k ν).map (Polynomial.evalRingHom N⁻¹) := by
  ext i j
  exact (bennettPolynomialResidue_homogenize Finset.univ a k ν N i j hN).symm

/-- The determinant of the cleared matrix evaluates to the single coefficient
of the original determinant at every nonzero value of the variable. -/
theorem bennettClearedMatrix_det_eval_of_ne_zero
    (a : I → F) (ha : Function.Injective a) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (ν : F) (q : I) (hq : a q = 0) (N : F) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    (bennettClearedMatrix a k ν).det.eval N =
      (bennettPolynomialMatrix a k ν).det.coeff (Fintype.card I * k) := by
  calc
    _ = ((bennettClearedMatrix a k ν).map (Polynomial.evalRingHom N)).det :=
      (Polynomial.evalRingHom N).map_det _
    _ = (N ^ k) ^ Fintype.card I *
        (bennettPolynomialMatrix a k ν).det.eval N⁻¹ := by
      rw [bennettClearedMatrix_eval a k ν N hN, Matrix.det_smul]
      exact congrArg (fun z : F => (N ^ k) ^ Fintype.card I * z)
        ((Polynomial.evalRingHom N⁻¹).map_det (bennettPolynomialMatrix a k ν)).symm
    _ = (N ^ k) ^ Fintype.card I *
        ((bennettPolynomialMatrix a k ν).det.coeff (Fintype.card I * k) *
          (N⁻¹) ^ (Fintype.card I * k)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [bennettPolynomialMatrix_det_monomial a ha k hk ν q hq]
      rw [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm k (Fintype.card I)]
      calc
        N ^ (Fintype.card I * k) *
            ((bennettPolynomialMatrix a k ν).det.coeff (Fintype.card I * k) *
              (N⁻¹) ^ (Fintype.card I * k)) =
            (bennettPolynomialMatrix a k ν).det.coeff (Fintype.card I * k) *
              (N ^ (Fintype.card I * k) * (N⁻¹) ^ (Fintype.card I * k)) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hN, one_pow, mul_one]

/-- The cleared determinant is a constant polynomial. Consequently evaluation
at a removed node, including zero, is justified algebraically. -/
theorem bennettClearedMatrix_det_constant
    (a : I → F) (ha : Function.Injective a) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (ν : F) (q : I) (hq : a q = 0) :
    (bennettClearedMatrix a k ν).det =
      Polynomial.C ((bennettPolynomialMatrix a k ν).det.coeff (Fintype.card I * k)) := by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  have hinf : Set.Infinite {N : F | N ≠ 0} := by
    have hset : {N : F | N ≠ 0} = Set.univ \ {0} := by
      ext N
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_univ, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
        true_and]
    rw [hset]
    exact (Set.infinite_univ : Set.Infinite (Set.univ : Set F)).sdiff
      (Set.finite_singleton (0 : F))
  apply hinf.mono
  intro N hN
  simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Polynomial.eval_C] using
    bennettClearedMatrix_det_eval_of_ne_zero a ha k hk ν q hq N hN

/-- Any two evaluations of the cleared determinant agree. -/
theorem bennettClearedMatrix_det_eval_eq
    (a : I → F) (ha : Function.Injective a) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (ν : F) (q : I) (hq : a q = 0) (N M : F) :
    (bennettClearedMatrix a k ν).det.eval N =
      (bennettClearedMatrix a k ν).det.eval M := by
  simp only [bennettClearedMatrix_det_constant a ha k hk ν q hq, Polynomial.eval_C]

end D1Bound5
CoherentTwoSize.lean:
import D1Bound5.CoherentTwoVanishing
import D1Bound5.CoherentQuotientForms

open Finset
open scoped NumberField
open Module

namespace D1Bound5

/-- A denominator-free numerical estimate underlying the two-anchor
nonvanishing argument.  The safe bound `5/4` on the scaled product of
three roots is slightly weaker than its exact square-root value, but
still gives the manuscript's strict constant five. -/
theorem coherent_two_scalar_size_bound
    (A B P U Q : ℝ)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hB : 3 ≤ B) (hP : 5 * B ≤ P) (hU0 : 0 ≤ U)
    (hU : U ^ 2 ≤ (A * B + 1) * (A * P + 1) * (B * P + 1))
    (hQ : Q ≤ A + B + P + 2 * A * B * P + 2 * U) :
    Q < 5 * A * B * P := by
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by linarith
  have hB0 : 0 < B := by linarith
  have hP15 : 15 ≤ P := by linarith
  have hP0 : 0 < P := by linarith
  have hAB : 3 ≤ A * B := by
    have h := mul_le_mul hA hB (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3) hA0.le
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hAP : 15 ≤ A * P := by
    have h := mul_le_mul hA hP15 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 15) hA0.le
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hBP : 45 ≤ B * P := by
    have h := mul_le_mul hB hP15 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 15) hB0.le
    nlinarith only [h]
  have h1 : A * B + 1 ≤ (4 / 3 : ℝ) * (A * B) := by linarith
  have h2 : A * P + 1 ≤ (16 / 15 : ℝ) * (A * P) := by linarith
  have h3 : B * P + 1 ≤ (46 / 45 : ℝ) * (B * P) := by linarith
  have hprod : (A * B + 1) * (A * P + 1) * (B * P + 1) ≤
      ((4 / 3 : ℝ) * (A * B)) * ((16 / 15 : ℝ) * (A * P)) *
        ((46 / 45 : ℝ) * (B * P)) :=
    mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (by positivity) (by positivity)) h3
      (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hscaled : U ^ 2 ≤ (2944 / 2025 : ℝ) * (A * B * P) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      U ^ 2 ≤ (A * B + 1) * (A * P + 1) * (B * P + 1) := hU
      _ ≤ _ := hprod
      _ = (2944 / 2025 : ℝ) * (A * B * P) ^ 2 := by ring
  have hT : 0 < A * B * P := by positivity
  have hUsq : U ^ 2 < ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * (A * B * P)) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith only [hscaled, sq_pos_of_pos hT]
  have hUbound : U < (5 / 4 : ℝ) * (A * B * P) :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ hU0 (by positivity)).mp hUsq
  have hAbound : 45 * A ≤ A * B * P := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBP hA0.le
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hBbound : 15 * B ≤ A * B * P := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAP hB0.le
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hPbound : 3 * P ≤ A * B * P := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAB hP0.le
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hsum : A + B + P ≤ (19 / 45 : ℝ) * (A * B * P) := by
    nlinarith only [hAbound, hBbound, hPbound]
  nlinarith only [hQ, hsum, hUbound, hT]

/-- The regular equation gives the usual two algebraic extensions of
a triple.  No division or nonzero-square-root hypothesis is used. -/
theorem regular_quadruple_eq_extensions
    {F : Type*} [Field F] (a b p q r s t : F)
    (hr : r ^ 2 = a * b + 1) (hs : s ^ 2 = a * p + 1)
    (ht : t ^ 2 = b * p + 1)
    (hreg : (a + b - p - q) ^ 2 = 4 * (a * b + 1) * (p * q + 1)) :
    q = a + b + p + 2 * a * b * p + 2 * (r * s * t) ∨
    q = a + b + p + 2 * a * b * p - 2 * (r * s * t) := by
  have hsq : (q - (a + b + p + 2 * a * b * p)) ^ 2 =
      (2 * (r * s * t)) ^ 2 := by
    linear_combination hreg - 4 * s ^ 2 * t ^ 2 * hr -
      4 * (a * b + 1) * t ^ 2 * hs -
      4 * (a * b + 1) * (a * p + 1) * ht
  rcases sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp hsq with h | h
  · left
    linear_combination h
  · right
    linear_combination h

/-- A regular complex quadruple with the size hypotheses used in the
strong two-anchor lemma has `Q < 5 A B P`. -/
theorem regular_quadruple_norm_lt_five
    (a b p q r s t : ℂ)
    (hr : r ^ 2 = a * b + 1) (hs : s ^ 2 = a * p + 1)
    (ht : t ^ 2 = b * p + 1)
    (hreg : (a + b - p - q) ^ 2 = 4 * (a * b + 1) * (p * q + 1))
    (hA : 1 ≤ ‖a‖) (hB : 3 ≤ ‖b‖) (hP : 5 * ‖b‖ ≤ ‖p‖) :
    ‖q‖ < 5 * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ * ‖p‖ := by
  have hroot (u v w : ℂ) (hw : w ^ 2 = u * v + 1) :
      ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖ + 1 := by
    calc
      ‖w‖ ^ 2 = ‖w ^ 2‖ := (norm_pow w 2).symm
      _ = ‖u * v + 1‖ := by rw [hw]
      _ ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖ + 1 := by
        simpa only [norm_mul, norm_one] using norm_add_le (u * v) (1 : ℂ)
  have hnr := hroot a b r hr
  have hns := hroot a p s hs
  have hnt := hroot b p t ht
  have hU : ‖r * s * t‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (‖a‖ * ‖b‖ + 1) * (‖a‖ * ‖p‖ + 1) * (‖b‖ * ‖p‖ + 1) := by
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, mul_pow, mul_pow]
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hnr hns (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)) hnt
      (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  have hcenter : ‖a + b + p + 2 * a * b * p‖ ≤
      ‖a‖ + ‖b‖ + ‖p‖ + 2 * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ * ‖p‖ := by
    have h1 := norm_add_le a b
    have h2 := norm_add_le (a + b) p
    have h3 := norm_add_le (a + b + p) (2 * a * b * p)
    simp only [norm_mul, Complex.norm_two] at h3
    linarith
  have hpert : ‖(2 : ℂ) * (r * s * t)‖ = 2 * ‖r * s * t‖ := by
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_two]
  have hQ : ‖q‖ ≤ ‖a‖ + ‖b‖ + ‖p‖ + 2 * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ * ‖p‖ +
      2 * ‖r * s * t‖ := by
    rcases regular_quadruple_eq_extensions a b p q r s t hr hs ht hreg with h | h
    · rw [h]
      have hh := norm_add_le (a + b + p + 2 * a * b * p) (2 * (r * s * t))
      rw [hpert] at hh
      linarith
    · rw [h]
      have hh := norm_sub_le (a + b + p + 2 * a * b * p) (2 * (r * s * t))
      rw [hpert] at hh
      linarith
  exact coherent_two_scalar_size_bound ‖a‖ ‖b‖ ‖p‖ ‖r * s * t‖ ‖q‖
    hA hB hP (norm_nonneg _) hU hQ

/-- The manuscript's actual large-terminal size hypothesis forces the
two-anchor coherent form nonzero, with no nonvanishing premise. -/
theorem coherent_analytic_two_ne_zero_of_large_terminal
    (a b p q eta r s t : ℂ)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (heta : eta ^ 2 = p * q)
    (hr : r ^ 2 = a * b + 1) (hs : s ^ 2 = a * p + 1)
    (ht : t ^ 2 = b * p + 1)
    (hA : 1 ≤ ‖a‖) (hB : 3 ≤ ‖b‖) (hP : 5 * ‖b‖ ≤ ‖p‖)
    (hQ : 5 * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ * ‖p‖ ≤ ‖q‖) :
    coherentAnchorRoot a p q eta - coherentAnchorRoot b p q eta -
      (a - b) * coherentTerminalRoot p q eta ≠ 0 := by
  apply coherent_analytic_two_ne_zero_of_not_regular a b p q eta ha hb hp hq hab heta
  intro hreg
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hQ) (regular_quadruple_norm_lt_five a b p q r s t
    hr hs ht hreg hA hB hP)

/-- The arithmetic and analytic bridges combined for actual tuple
entries.  The paper's size assumptions force the coherent form nonzero
and therefore give its integral lower bound, with neither fact assumed. -/
theorem full_ring_coherent_two_nonzero_and_one_le_norm
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K]
    (hK : finrank ℚ K = 2) (phi : K →+* ℂ)
    {T : Finset (𝓞 K)} (hT : IsD1 T) (a b p q : 𝓞 K)
    (ha : a ∈ T) (hb : b ∈ T) (hp : p ∈ T) (hq : q ∈ T)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hap : a ≠ p) (haq : a ≠ q)
    (hbp : b ≠ p) (hbq : b ≠ q) (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (eta : ℂ) (heta : eta ^ 2 = phi (p : K) * phi (q : K))
    (hB : 3 ≤ ‖phi (b : K)‖) (hP : 5 * ‖phi (b : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (p : K)‖)
    (hQ : 5 * ‖phi (a : K)‖ * ‖phi (b : K)‖ * ‖phi (p : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (q : K)‖) :
    let L := coherentAnchorRoot (phi (a : K)) (phi (p : K)) (phi (q : K)) eta -
      coherentAnchorRoot (phi (b : K)) (phi (p : K)) (phi (q : K)) eta -
      (phi (a : K) - phi (b : K)) *
        coherentTerminalRoot (phi (p : K)) (phi (q : K)) eta
    L ≠ 0 ∧ 1 ≤ ‖L‖ := by
  dsimp only
  let f : 𝓞 K →+* ℂ := phi.comp (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K)
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply NumberField.RingOfIntegers.ext
    exact phi.injective hxy
  have hnz (u : 𝓞 K) (hu : u ∈ T) : f u ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hT.1 u hu (hf (by simpa only [map_zero] using h))
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hT.2 a ha b hb hab
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hT.2 a ha p hp hap
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hT.2 b hb p hp hbp
  have hr' : (f r) ^ 2 = f a * f b + 1 := by
    simpa only [pow_two, map_mul, map_add, map_one] using congrArg f hr
  have hs' : (f s) ^ 2 = f a * f p + 1 := by
    simpa only [pow_two, map_mul, map_add, map_one] using congrArg f hs
  have ht' : (f t) ^ 2 = f b * f p + 1 := by
    simpa only [pow_two, map_mul, map_add, map_one] using congrArg f ht
  have hnonzero := coherent_analytic_two_ne_zero_of_large_terminal
    (f a) (f b) (f p) (f q) eta (f r) (f s) (f t)
    (hnz a ha) (hnz b hb) (hnz p hp) (hnz q hq) (fun h => hab (hf h))
    heta hr' hs' ht' (one_le_norm_integer hK phi (hT.1 a ha)) hB hP hQ
  refine ⟨hnonzero, ?_⟩
  let av : Fin 2 → 𝓞 K := ![a, b]
  let cv : Fin 2 → 𝓞 K := ![1, -1]
  have hav : ∀ i, av i ∈ T := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [av, ha, hb]
  have havp : ∀ i, av i ≠ p := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [av, hap, hbp]
  have havq : ∀ i, av i ≠ q := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [av, haq, hbq]
  have hE :
      -phi ((a - b : 𝓞 K) : K) * coherentTerminalRoot (f p) (f q) eta +
        (∑ i : Fin 2, phi (cv i : K) * coherentAnchorRoot (phi (av i : K)) (f p) (f q) eta) =
      coherentAnchorRoot (f a) (f p) (f q) eta -
        coherentAnchorRoot (f b) (f p) (f q) eta -
        (f a - f b) * coherentTerminalRoot (f p) (f q) eta := by
    change -f (a - b) * coherentTerminalRoot (f p) (f q) eta +
      (∑ i : Fin 2, f (cv i) * coherentAnchorRoot (f (av i)) (f p) (f q) eta) = _
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, av, cv]
    ring
  have hE0 :
      -phi ((a - b : 𝓞 K) : K) * coherentTerminalRoot (f p) (f q) eta +
        (∑ i : Fin 2, phi (cv i : K) * coherentAnchorRoot (phi (av i : K)) (f p) (f q) eta) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hE]
    exact hnonzero
  have hlow := full_ring_coherent_linear_form_one_le_norm hK phi hT hp hq hpq
    av cv (a - b) hav havp havq eta heta hE0
  change 1 ≤ ‖-phi ((a - b : 𝓞 K) : K) * coherentTerminalRoot (f p) (f q) eta +
    (∑ i : Fin 2, phi (cv i : K) * coherentAnchorRoot (phi (av i : K)) (f p) (f q) eta)‖ at hlow
  rw [hE] at hlow
  exact hlow

end D1Bound5
CoherentFormBounds.lean:
import D1Bound5.CoherentQuotientForms
import D1Bound5.CoherentNearOne

open Finset

namespace D1Bound5

/-- The complete homogeneous remainder for the actual reciprocal
terminal parameters.  The finite-subtype indexing matches the proved
Lagrange interpolation theorem exactly. -/
noncomputable def coherentRemainder {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → ℂ) (p q : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' j : ℕ, halfBinomialWeightedCoeff p⁻¹ q⁻¹ (m + j) *
    MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)) => (a i)⁻¹)
      (MvPolynomial.hsymm (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)) ℂ j)

/-- The normalized exact identity for the actual manuscript form,
including the precise coherent branch choices and all quotient weights. -/
theorem coherentQuotientForm_normalized_eq
    {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → ℂ) (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0) (hinj : Function.Injective a)
    (Delta p q eta : ℂ) (hDelta : Delta ≠ 0) (heta : eta ≠ 0)
    (hp : ∀ i, ‖p⁻¹ * (a i)⁻¹‖ < 1)
    (hq : ∀ i, ‖q⁻¹ * (a i)⁻¹‖ < 1) :
    coherentQuotientForm a Delta p q eta / (Delta * eta) =
      1 - ((1 + p⁻¹ * q⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)) +
        ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (m - 1) * (∏ i, a i)⁻¹) * coherentRemainder a p q := by
  let g : Fin m → ℂ := fun i =>
    ((1 + p⁻¹ * (a i)⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)) *
      ((1 + q⁻¹ * (a i)⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ))
  have hs : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).Nonempty :=
    ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have hnorm : coherentQuotientForm a Delta p q eta / (Delta * eta) =
      (∑ i, ((a i) ^ (m - 1) /
        (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (a i - a j))) * g i) -
        ((1 + p⁻¹ * q⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [coherentQuotientForm, coherentTerminalRoot, coherentAnchorRoot,
      Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, g, mul_assoc] using
      coherent_interpolation_normalization Finset.univ a g
        ((1 + p⁻¹ * q⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)) Delta eta
        (by simpa using hm) hDelta heta
  have h := coherent_half_binomial_exact Finset.univ a hs
    (fun i _ => ha i) hinj.injOn p⁻¹ q⁻¹ (fun i _ => hp i) (fun i _ => hq i)
  have hsum : (∑ i, ((a i) ^ (m - 1) /
        (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (a i - a j))) * g i) =
      1 + ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (m - 1) * (∏ i, a i)⁻¹) * coherentRemainder a p q := by
    simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, coherentRemainder, g] using h.2
  rw [hnorm, hsum]
  ring

/-- The manuscript tail estimate applied directly to the remainder in
the actual coherent form. -/
theorem coherentRemainder_norm_sub_le
    {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → ℂ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (p q : ℂ) (A P : ℝ)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hP : 0 < P) (ha : ∀ i, A ≤ ‖a i‖)
    (hp : ‖p⁻¹‖ ≤ 1 / P) (hq : ‖q⁻¹‖ ≤ 1 / P) (hAP : 1 < A * P) :
    ‖coherentRemainder a p q - halfBinomialWeightedCoeff p⁻¹ q⁻¹ m‖ ≤
      (4 * |halfBinomialCoeff (m + 1)|) / P ^ m *
        (1 / (1 - 1 / (A * P)) ^ m - 1) := by
  have hs : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).Nonempty :=
    ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have h := coherent_half_binomial_manuscript_tail_norm_le Finset.univ a hs
    p⁻¹ q⁻¹ A P hA hP (fun i _ => ha i) hp hq hAP
  simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, coherentRemainder] using h.2

/-- An explicit upper bound for the actual coherent form, derived from
its exact analytic identity and the proved coefficient remainder.  This
is the common input for the numerical two-, three-, and four-anchor
estimates; no bound on an unspecified analytic remainder is assumed. -/
theorem coherentQuotientForm_norm_le
    {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → ℂ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hinj : Function.Injective a)
    (Delta p q eta : ℂ) (hDelta : Delta ≠ 0) (heta : eta ≠ 0)
    (A P : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hP : 0 < P) (ha : ∀ i, A ≤ ‖a i‖)
    (hp : ‖p⁻¹‖ ≤ 1 / P) (hq : ‖q⁻¹‖ ≤ 1 / P) (hAP : 1 < A * P) :
    ‖coherentQuotientForm a Delta p q eta‖ ≤ ‖Delta‖ * ‖eta‖ *
      (‖1 - ((1 + p⁻¹ * q⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ))‖ +
        (‖halfBinomialWeightedCoeff p⁻¹ q⁻¹ m‖ +
          (4 * |halfBinomialCoeff (m + 1)|) / P ^ m *
            (1 / (1 - 1 / (A * P)) ^ m - 1)) / (∏ i, ‖a i‖)) := by
  let E : ℝ := (4 * |halfBinomialCoeff (m + 1)|) / P ^ m *
    (1 / (1 - 1 / (A * P)) ^ m - 1)
  let c : ℂ := (-1 : ℂ) ^ (m - 1) * (∏ i, a i)⁻¹
  have han : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    exact norm_pos_iff.mp (hA.trans_le (ha i))
  have hxp : ∀ i, ‖p⁻¹ * (a i)⁻¹‖ < 1 := by
    intro i
    exact coherent_half_binomial_manuscript_anchor_radius Finset.univ a p⁻¹ A P
      hA hP (fun j _ => ha j) hp hAP i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hxq : ∀ i, ‖q⁻¹ * (a i)⁻¹‖ < 1 := by
    intro i
    exact coherent_half_binomial_manuscript_anchor_radius Finset.univ a q⁻¹ A P
      hA hP (fun j _ => ha j) hq hAP i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hexact := coherentQuotientForm_normalized_eq a hm han hinj
    Delta p q eta hDelta heta hxp hxq
  have hmul : coherentQuotientForm a Delta p q eta = (Delta * eta) *
      (1 - ((1 + p⁻¹ * q⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)) + c * coherentRemainder a p q) := by
    have h := (div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero hDelta heta)).mp hexact
    calc
      coherentQuotientForm a Delta p q eta =
        (1 - ((1 + p⁻¹ * q⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)) + c * coherentRemainder a p q) *
          (Delta * eta) := h
      _ = _ := mul_comm _ _
  have htail : ‖coherentRemainder a p q - halfBinomialWeightedCoeff p⁻¹ q⁻¹ m‖ ≤ E :=
    coherentRemainder_norm_sub_le a hm p q A P hA hP ha hp hq hAP
  have hF : ‖coherentRemainder a p q‖ ≤ ‖halfBinomialWeightedCoeff p⁻¹ q⁻¹ m‖ + E := by
    have h := norm_add_le (coherentRemainder a p q - halfBinomialWeightedCoeff p⁻¹ q⁻¹ m)
      (halfBinomialWeightedCoeff p⁻¹ q⁻¹ m)
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
    linarith
  have hc : ‖c‖ = (∏ i, ‖a i‖)⁻¹ := by
    simp [c, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_inv, norm_prod]
  have hprod0 : 0 ≤ ∏ i, ‖a i‖ := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg _)
  rw [hmul, norm_mul, norm_mul]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity : 0 ≤ ‖Delta‖ * ‖eta‖)
  calc
    ‖1 - ((1 + p⁻¹ * q⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)) + c * coherentRemainder a p q‖ ≤
      ‖1 - ((1 + p⁻¹ * q⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ))‖ + ‖c * coherentRemainder a p q‖ :=
        norm_add_le _ _
    _ = ‖1 - ((1 + p⁻¹ * q⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ))‖ +
        (∏ i, ‖a i‖)⁻¹ * ‖coherentRemainder a p q‖ := by rw [norm_mul, hc]
    _ ≤ ‖1 - ((1 + p⁻¹ * q⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ))‖ +
        (∏ i, ‖a i‖)⁻¹ * (‖halfBinomialWeightedCoeff p⁻¹ q⁻¹ m‖ + E) :=
      add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF (inv_nonneg.mpr hprod0))
    _ = _ := by dsimp only [E]; ring

end D1Bound5
